chunks: And Aban narrated from Zurarah, from Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام, who said:
“A man is given the hadd punishment while standing, and a woman while sitting. Every limb is struck, and the face and the private parts are left.”

key_terms.الْمَذَاكِيرُ: the private parts, which are excluded from being struck
key_terms.الْوَجْهُ: the face, which is excluded from being struck
key_terms.قَائِمًا: standing, describing the man’s position during the punishment
key_terms.قَاعِدَةً: sitting, describing the woman’s position during the punishment

ai.seo_question: How is the hadd punishment administered to a man and a woman according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the manner in which the hadd punishment is carried out on men and women. It also specifies bodily limits in execution of the punishment, excluding the face and the private parts from being struck.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5011 - Narrated by Aban from Zurara from Abu Jafar Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:
"A man is subjected to the prescribed punishment (hadd) while standing, and a woman while sitting. Every part of the body is struck except the face and the private parts."
